title: Bounded constructible finite-Tor domains on the two small sites
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme and $A$ a finite commutative ring. Use the ordinary small-etale module derived category [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] and the ordinary small-pro-etale module derived category [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. Define $C_{\mathrm{et}}(T,A)$ as the object predicate of bounded constructible complexes [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes] having Tor amplitude in $[a,b]$ for some integers $a\le b$ [def-kun-tor-amplitude]. Define $C_{\mathrm{proet}}(T,A)$ as the object predicate of complexes whose cohomology is bounded, whose every cohomology sheaf is intrinsically constructible on a finite locally closed constructible partition [def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf], and which have Tor amplitude in $[a,b]$ for some integers $a\le b$ against every pro-etale module sheaf [def-weil-proetale-tor-amplitude]. In each case the corresponding category is the full subcategory cut out by this predicate. These predicates impose no etale-origin condition and assert no comparison theorem.
